title: Implement public gradient objects and shared Adam/distribution ownership
body:
## Current candidate and admission status

Current head: af33d1065a3b097990e9536df5b22b1a3fb315cf
Current tree: 88ed6bd6a41ca0e58e653b3d76718090b3bbba64

All eight checks on this exact head have completed successfully. Both native jobs executed all 76 steps successfully; the quick 355 and 428 jobs each executed all 13 steps successfully. The final PR native run is [43862154942](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/HeptaTorch/actions/runs/43862154942); the two-profile quick run is [43862154875](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/HeptaTorch/actions/runs/43862154875).

Final original artifact admission is complete: 58 original reports with the unchanged 30 required envelope paths, 294 main journal members, and 185 members for each quick artifact. All original bytes were checked against the official ZIP digests and every recorded member digest. Both profiles in both workflows actually ran the unchanged live32 and all frozen35 cases. Each frozen35 result has 6,344 frames, 2,590,274 compared values, all 11 provenance checks, all original EOF and final parameter Version gates, zero direct parameter Version differences, and the same 283 legacy explicit-state Version differences.

The independent offline admission completed 59,251 checks with zero failures. Its exact report SHA256 is `694bf7fc8f05d41715aa7ab12c8d196b2ebfab159ad9a1f227c9260b2641176b`; reviewer source is `123aa0b96823a5f78d14a1998ab5cb992ac7172b65304b11905bc0d457967f59`. It separately binds the real hosted native executions and does not itself execute native code or Torch. The original failure reports below remain failures.

The original head 30ea38d actually failed the 355 frozen35 close-count assertion (3 PASS / 32 FAIL); the corresponding common-428 live32/frozen35 steps were skipped. Its complete original 54-report ZIP, raw job metadata and generated merge identity are now committed under validation/private-node-accounting/first-hosted-failure-30ea38d/. That result remains FAILURE.

Candidate 1d45ea9 introduced exact read-only native allocation/root/reference/rollback accounting. Its two hosted matrix jobs each passed three actual native controls (13 frames), then each failed the seventeenth independent corruption control. The checker had preserved a shared Python before/after snapshot identity during deepcopy, so its attempted one-sided digest corruption changed both sides. The native rollback assertion itself was correct.

This candidate fixes only the test-copy isolation: independent JSON value copies, explicit distinct-object and unchanged-before checks. All 18 named rejection rules are identical; a byte inverse recovers the original checker. The corrected c4873900 checker passed four positive samples and all 18 exact rejection controls on both original hosted journals. Both first failed CI artifacts and all 47 replay evidence files are preserved under validation/private-node-accounting/negative-control-alias-fix/. These offline replays execute no native code or Torch.

Separately, the unchanged e900466b observer and 65c0d687 launcher completed the original 355 frozen35 on the fixed ROG CPython 3.12 / pinned Torch environment: 35/35, 6,344 frames, 2,590,274 values, all 11 provenance checks, all original EOF and final parameter Version gates; 4,550 original creation tickets plus 42 actual private gradient nodes; zero direct parameter Version differences. The 283 recorded legacy explicit-state Version differences remain unchanged. This separate result is not relabeled as hosted CI for the current head.

The native sources/ELFs, original case implementations and tolerances remain frozen. The main workflow declares 71 steps; the completed native jobs each have 76 actual steps. The final export contains 58 original root JSON reports and the unchanged 30 envelope paths. Both current-head matrix outcomes and the complete original report bytes have been independently verified. Journal custody is exported separately and binds exact original reports, raw owner snapshots, wire traces and checkout/run identity.

Full target remains PyTorch v2.15.0, 2,590 schemas, 688 derivative entries and all whole-system gates. Full-schema parity remains 0 and the full rewrite remains HOLD.

---

## Native implementation and preserved first-head history

## Problem

Public gradients need real Tensor/Storage/Version identity and independently retained aliases. The prior Adam/distribution owner still used the older private-gradient path. Combining these implementations also exposed actual transposed zero-first gradient corruption, incorrect pointwise output layouts, scalar NaN sign/payload changes and four extreme size-one stride mismatches.

## Native changes

Introduce the frozen 355-function gradient-object parent and a 428-function common owner for public gradients, SGD/Adam/AdamW state, Generators, Bernoulli/dropout, Saved values and graph lifetimes. Production arithmetic, allocation, mutation and reference release execute in native HIA. Python only composes exact source bodies, invokes the pinned native compiler/linker, transports test packets and checks observations.

The common profile has5,738 core blocks,21,348 instructions and9 real native units, with576-byte descriptors and `HTGAD002` / `HTOGAD02`. Its source is `1fed8ea7ba5bf755a9df9ca1e61d34cfd4712cc2fd66e0728493091c81c24dae`; executable is `6773485896d961b6c2e62784ebb66320290df47128bd1331aecc0c8b7f6611fe`. The gradient parent is source `1b18da2c…`, executable `be18ab87…`. Both portable builders admit only the exact parent receipts, sources, units and compiler/linker pins.

- Public grad get/assignment/clear preserves actual Tensor identity, Storage, Version, external aliases and private ownership.
- Physical Preserve-layout incoming Storage is managed separately from logical gradient work, including reservation, merge, rollback and release.
- Pointwise stores use the actual selected layout. The final05 signed-byte stride comparator is the only change from04;427 other core bodies are byte-identical.
- A narrow scalar-add helper preserves the fixed CPU observations for NaN sign/payload and opposite infinities. Its finite path and the global arithmetic helper remain unchanged.
- Original Optimizer24 case20 is newly mapped through actual public-gradient alias behavior. The explicit union is23 qualified cases and one partial retained-nonleaf case; old report classifications are preserved.

## Actual local execution

Root independently cold-builds the355 parent through both overlay and complete authoring lineage:16/16 steps pass with identical source and ELF. Root also cold-builds the common05 owner and executes the complete default CI entry, including a new17-step producer run,3 native compiler/entry/typed-owner gates,4 immutable independent runners and the native8/strict344-field extreme-stride comparison. All pass on the exact common image. The default entry does not reuse a producer receipt.

The root common report is10,419,557 bytes, SHA-256 `a753d00c5053f0da3d5a146ee3e98587fcb132548c5b36ec1a7872ffba631df8`. It binds427 unchanged inputs and embeds the original child reports with their original hashes. Its complete raw archive retains2,048 files/164,644,657 expanded bytes; the3,671,920-byte archive SHA is `458fab50d7eb4c9685fd400053dd6746225ccae348e75c758d1e0cbd6d8fb6fe`. An additional read-only custody review validates the actual default path and every input; it is not counted as extra numerical testing.

Separate fixed suites retain their scope:
- public10:9 qualified/1 partial; incoming25:22 qualified/3 unrepresented; alias12 and Bernoulli gradient8 pass;
- scalarNaN48, actual mixed-layout2, cross-feature6, mathematical2 and extreme-stride8 pass;
- distribution183 stays161 pass/4 transaction differences/18 unrepresented under the old atomic contract, and165 pass/18 unrepresented under explicit86/87;
- original presence8/clear10 lifecycle and tolerated-word differences remain unchanged.

These overlapping counts are not summed into unique upstream API coverage. Real OOM recovery, transient reserve cleanup, ordinary full-owner rollback, public/private/Weak lifetimes and wrong-producer owner rejection are exercised separately.

## Integration and preserved evidence

Add `make test-gradient-objects` and `make test-gradient-adam-distributions`. Six new Native CI steps qualify each new image and run its unchanged live32 and frozen35 PyTorch oracles. All63 original declared steps remain byte-identical and ordered; the workflow now has69 declared steps,30 required envelopes and a40-minute timeout for the extra cold builds and regressions. Expected actual hosted job count is74 including runner setup/cleanup.

All fixed oracle inputs, expected values, tolerances and Version assertions remain unchanged. An unpublished355 CLI integration error was corrected to the actual supported arguments; all four final oracle commands were executed with preparation-only parsing and source checks. These preparations retain NOT_RUN identity. The previous static517-check review and original rejected command are preserved.

Complete original producer/peer packets and candidate01–05 failure history remain in validation. The compiled but unqualified03 is not promoted. The04 four-stride failure, earlier wrong-order/NaN/layout failures, observer-tag corrections and exact inverse diffs remain separate. Frozen original whitespace in historical source/snapshots/diffs is preserved by exact hash. No old failure is rewritten.

This PR also preserves the complete admitted PR26 and PR23 original hosted artifacts and main readbacks, plus the actual retained-nonleaf reference from merged PR27. The proposed reference-parent metadata records the earlier staging event; its dependency is now satisfied: verified main is `dcb903ccbb679497f4c7fa3c413dc0f6d19340ef`, tree `ffe43fc…`. This implementation commit is directly based on that verified main.

## Remaining admission and scope

The first exact-head PR run `43850393178` completed with a real failure at step66. Both new native qualification steps and the355 live32 step passed, but the355 frozen35 report is FAIL:3 pass and32 fail. The428 live32/frozen35 steps were skipped, so they have no actual result in this run. The original artifact `14219765370` is3,914,565 bytes, SHA-256 `ac4f9a5af8cbb8ec58db4ee5a015b8789b159835dd370ea213fe8dd582e0ed8c`; all54 original reports and the PARTIAL manifest have been recovered and verified without reserialization.

All32 failures reach the old bridge's final assertion that the native physical node sequence equals the original client's logical creation sequence. Real public-gradient objects add private HIA nodes. The original native statistic remains accurate; changing its reported count would be incorrect. The numerical and lifetime case functions returned, but these close failures also prevented the original EOF/exit/empty-output checks and final strict parameter-Version summary assertion. Those unexecuted obligations are not counted as passes.

A separately audited read-only observation adapter is being implemented to account for actual private-gradient incarnations, exact native allocation counters, live roots and reset boundaries. The original35/28/21 inputs, numerical assertions, tolerances, Version assertions and original failed report remain unchanged. Both images must rerun the complete strict suite after the adapter is verified. This PR remains Draft and is not eligible to merge. The predecessor378 results are not inherited. Retained-nonleaf native implementation is a separate successor; hooks, higher-order AD, broader dtype/layout/device support, eighteen missing distribution cases and the other full-system requirements remain open.

Whole-project acceptance stays HOLD, full-schema parity stays0, and all2,590 schemas plus17 full-system gates remain in the target. See `docs/gradient-objects-and-composition.md`, the exact manifests and `validation/gradient-adam-distributions-root/` for reproducible commands and complete evidence.
